documents.notes: Relation carries fixme:s='needs source for boundary lines' and no source tags, so it is never treated as authoritative by itself. Production use is restricted to the post-Adrianople 1713–1720 interval only after broad spatial controls and independent primary-document corroboration. Its nominal 1699 start is explicitly ignored because the polygon excludes Azov and therefore cannot represent Russian possession of Azov before the Pruth settlement.
